description: Parallel batch webpage and PDF document extraction tool (pdf, pdf-to-markdown, pdf text extraction, pdf ocr alternative, whitepaper, rfc, academic paper, spa, anti-bot, stealth chromium). Fetches up to 5 public URLs concurrently with Markdown, fenced code blocks, OpenGraph metadata, JSON-LD, pricing tables, and fair settlement (502 if all fail).
